definition: to introduce someone new into a group
description: Inside a wooden barn on a cold winter morning, a young man in a waxed jacket and green rubber boots, with a towel hanging from his pocket, bends down and gently sets a newborn black-and-white lamb onto the straw. He straightens up and watches as a ewe stretches forward to sniff the lamb, which stands on its own. A flock of white sheep crowds behind, a sheepdog sits by the metal gate, hay bales are stacked above, an oil lantern glows and breath steams in the air.
